API, contract, property-based, integration, security and load tests **in Python**. They run against a Bookshop API of our own, written with FastAPI and SQLite.

## At a glance

- **System under test:** own Bookshop API (`services/bookshop`): catalogue, customers with signed tokens, orders with coupons and stock
- **Language and tools:** Python 3.13 · pytest + httpx · Hypothesis · Schemathesis · Locust · Allure · ruff · mypy (strict)
- **Types of testing:** functional API, contract (OpenAPI), property-based, database integration, security, load
- **Tests:** 77 (pytest, 4 workers, ~16 s) + a Locust load job
- **Test quality:** 11/11 planted bugs caught (`scripts/mutants.py`)
- **Reports:** [Allure](https://nailkarimov.github.io/python-testing/) · [visual guide](https://nailkarimov.github.io/python-testing/python.html)

## Defects

5 bug reports in [Issues](https://github.com/NailKarimov/python-testing/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Abug): 0 open, 5 closed. Each has steps, expected and actual results and a severity.

## What v1.0.0 means

The suite is complete for its scope and green in CI; the README follows the portfolio standard, and the test plan and test summary report (ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3) are in `docs/`. Later versions will be tagged when the scope grows.
